text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Twenty-six hundred and sixty, entitled "An Act establishing and
regulating trading systems in the Department of Mindanao and Sulu," is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. The Mountain Province, the Provinces of Nueva Vizcaya, Agusan, Bukidnon, Cotabato, Davao,
Lanao, Zamboanga, and Sulu may severally establish trading storse or exhanges to be known as trading
systems to facilitate the production and sale of the products of local Agriculture and industry, or their
exchange for needed merchandise, and to extend the commercial relations of the mohammedans and pagans
with christian elements of population. There may be operated in connection therewith public markets, stores,
workshops, transportation lines and such other public utilities as may be helpful in carrying on the said trading
system. Subject to the approval of the Secretary of the Interior, said provinces may, through the
instrumentality of their trading systems, promote, organize, operate, and liquidate corporations, or invest part
of their funds in such corporations, for the purpose ofd promoting agriculture and industries, when such
course will best promote the general welfare, especially with reference to food production, cattle-breeding and
agricultural development."
Approved, March 23, 1920.
